description: Pick logo colourways per background. Give `colours` (brand palette: hex, rgb() or hsl(), optionally named, e.g. 'Ink #14213d, Paper #fff8ec, Flame #fca311'; first is the primary), optionally `logo` (the colours inside the full-colour logo, default the primary only) and `backgrounds` (default: each brand colour plus white and black). For each background it reports whether the full-colour logo reaches 3:1, and if not, which one-colour version (a brand colour, then white, then black) reaches 4.5:1 or at least 3:1, with ratios. Also suggests the set of colourways to produce.

backgrounds.description: Backgrounds to test (default: brand colours, white, black)

colours.description: Brand colours, hex/rgb/hsl, optionally named. First is primary.

logo.description: Colours used inside the full-colour logo (default: the primary colour)

name: logo_contrast_variants
title: Logo colourways
